subject: gk
question: Privatisation implies ________ a government owned enterprise.

options.text: shedding of the ownership or management of
restricting private players to take control of

solution:
The correct answer is __**shedding of the ownership or management of**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Privatisation involves the transfer of ownership or management from the public sector (government) to the private sector.
 
• This process is aimed at increasing efficiency and profitability by leveraging private sector management practices and investment.
 
• Privatisation can take various forms, including the sale of government-owned enterprises, public-private partnerships (PPPs), and outsourcing of services.
 
• It is often part of broader economic reforms to stimulate competition, attract foreign investment, and reduce the fiscal burden on the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Public Sector:**

 
 
• Refers to government-owned organizations and enterprises that provide goods or services to the public.
 
• These entities are funded and operated by the government and are aimed at serving the public interest.
 
 
 
• **Private Sector:**
 
 
• Consists of businesses and enterprises that are owned and operated by private individuals or companies.
 
• The primary goal of private sector entities is to generate profit and they operate under competitive market conditions.
 
 
 
• **Public-Private Partnership (PPP):**
 
 
• A collaborative arrangement between government and private sector entities to undertake projects or provide services.
 
• PPPs leverage the efficiency and expertise of the private sector while ensuring that public objectives are met.
 
 
 
• **Economic Reforms:**
 
 
• Policies and measures implemented by a government to improve the economic performance and efficiency of a country.
 
• Reforms often include deregulation, liberalization, privatization, and measures to enhance competition and attract investment.
